cases.name: final-stage-hardening

files.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12 AS build
RUN python -m compileall /app
FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
COPY --from=build /app /app
USER app:app
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD python -m app.health

cases.tradeoff: L3 requires explicit effective final-stage non-root USER and active HEALTHCHECK plus multiple authored stages; inherited image defaults are missed.

cases.name: final-stage-reset

files.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12 AS build
RUN python -m compileall /app
FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
COPY --from=build /app /app
USER app:app
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD python -m app.health
USER root
HEALTHCHECK NONE

cases.tradeoff: Later final-stage USER/HEALTHCHECK instructions reset earlier hardening and must fail closed.

cases.name: heredoc-keywords

files.Dockerfile:
FROM alpine
RUN <<EOF
USER app
HEALTHCHECK CMD true
EOF

cases.tradeoff: Heredoc body keywords are data, not Docker instructions; one real stage remains below L2/L3.

cases.name: unresolved-user-arg

files.Dockerfile:
FROM alpine AS build
RUN true
FROM alpine AS runtime
ARG APP_USER
USER $APP_USER
HEALTHCHECK CMD true

cases.tradeoff: An ARG without a static default cannot prove a non-root effective USER.

cases.name: pre-from-arg-not-redeclared

files.Dockerfile:
ARG APP_USER=app
FROM alpine AS build
RUN true
FROM alpine AS runtime
USER $APP_USER
HEALTHCHECK CMD true

cases.tradeoff: A pre-FROM ARG can parameterize FROM but is not available to USER unless the final stage redeclares it; unresolved build-time values fail closed.
